title: Introduction to Options Pricing Models: Black-Scholes Explained
description: A rigorous but accessible walkthrough of how options are actually priced, built for aspiring quant analysts, prop trading applicants, and traders who want to move past chart-reading into the math underneath. Covers geometric Brownian motion, risk-neutral valuation, the Black-Scholes formula step by step, and the Greeks that drive real hedging decisions. Uses Nifty and Bank Nifty option chains, India VIX, and Zerodha/NSE data throughout so every formula lands on a real, checkable Indian market number.
